text: 100% of NSPK, the operator of the Mir payment system, belongs to the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, which is NSPK's sole shareholder.
short: Central Bank of Russia owns 100% of NSPK (Mir)

source.name: NSPK (National Payment Card System): О компании (About NSPK)
source.note: Company page (Russian). Undated; site footer says © 2026. The site's TLS chain failed Python's verification for our checker, so it needs to be opened by hand; quote verified with curl. English: '100% of shares of JSC NSPK belong to the Central Bank of the Russian Federation'.
source.quote: 100% акций АО «НСПК» принадлежит Центральному банку Российской Федерации

additionalSources.name: Interfax: Банк России может начать переговоры о продаже НСПК в октябре
additionalSources.note: English: 'The sole shareholder of NSPK is the Bank of Russia.' The same report says the Central Bank must keep a controlling stake (at least 50% plus one share) in any sale of NSPK shares.
additionalSources.quote: Единственным акционером НСПК является Банк России.
